text: Run tasks from a phone or any machine via app.humanlayer.com for remote control
quote: This tutorial teaches you how to run one task on a remote machine. You will control the task from app.humanlayer.com on a machine or phone.

text: Connect Jira Cloud so tasks are created automatically from Jira tickets
quote: Connect Jira Cloud so HumanLayer can create tasks from Jira tickets and keep ticket-driven agent work connected to its source.

text: Connect Linear so tasks are created from Linear issues and status stays synced
quote: Connect Linear so HumanLayer can create tasks from Linear issues, sync issue status, and link HumanLayer artifacts back to the source issue.

text: Connect GitHub so tasks can be created from issues and linked back to them
quote: Connect GitHub to create HumanLayer tasks from issues and link task artifacts back to the source issue.

text: Send task artifact updates into Slack channels
quote: Connect Slack to send HumanLayer task artifact updates into the channels where your team already works.

text: Choose the shortest workflow path (e.g. Oneshot) matched to the risk of the change
quote: Use the shortest path that controls the main risk. A clear and small change can use Oneshot. A change with unclear behavior or code shape needs more review before implementation.

text: Select between Oneshot, RPI, PRD-Oriented, or Freeform task workflow modes
quote: Select **Oneshot**, **RPI**, **PRD-Oriented**, or **Freeform**.

text: Choose a host (cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine) with access to needed code, tools, and credentials
quote: The host can be a cloud VM, workstation, or private-network machine. Select a host that can access the code, tools, credentials, and private services that the agent needs.

text: Configure a multi-repository workspace with a primary repo and setup preferences
quote: Configure a multi-repository workspace with this repository, ../api, and ../web. Make ../web the primary repository. Ask me before you choose setup commands or local files to copy.

text: Run a Cloud-visible coding session from CI jobs, cron machines, or scripts via the automation CLI
quote: Use `humanlayer automation run` to run one Cloud-visible coding session from any automation environment — a CI job, a cron machine, or a script on a server.

text: Use a launch token to authorize a single non-interactive automation command
quote: Use a launch token for one non-interactive command. Examples include a shell without an interactive PTY and a one-time remote bootstrap script.

text: Install, authenticate, and select Codex as the model for HumanLayer sessions
quote: This guide shows you how to install, authenticate, select, and check Codex for HumanLayer sessions.

text: Run Claude sessions through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API
quote: HumanLayer sessions can run Claude through Amazon Bedrock instead of the Anthropic API.

text: Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view
quote: Draft PR creation — Ask the session agent to open a draft pull request from the GitHub tab or diff view.

text: Paste images directly into a new task as attachments for visual context
quote: Image paste in new tasks — Paste images straight into the new task composer as attachments.

text: Live multiplayer editing of response drafts with shared cursors and presence
quote: Live multiplayer response drafts — Write prompts together with shared text, named cursors, presence, read-only viewing, and draft recovery.

text: View usage, cost, and productivity metrics for paid plans
quote: Advanced Metrics for all paid plans — View usage, cost, and productivity metrics, with optional access for every organization member.

text: Tasks maintain a shared history that can continue across agents and workstations
quote: A HumanLayer task gives one piece of work: A group of related sessions, A shared set of task files, One place for comments and review, A history that can continue across agents and workstations

text: HumanLayer registers RPI sub-agents for Claude Code sessions
quote: HumanLayer registers these RPI sub-agents for Claude Code sessions

text: Use workspace.json and workspace.local.json for shared and machine-specific configuration
quote: Use `.humanlayer/workspace.json` for shared repository or team configuration. Use `.humanlayer/workspace.local.json` for optional user or machine overrides.
